Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644' to activities.assay_id. Join activities.molregno to molecule_dictionary.molregno. Join molecule_dictionary.molregno to compound_structures.molregno. Filter assay CHEMBL1217644. Filter standard_relation = '='. Filter standard_value IS NOT NULL. Filter standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
